findings.passage: "The great people of Lycoming, and now Sullivan County need to know that I am fighting for them. I am a fiscal conservative, fighting for smaller government, standing up for and protecting our Constitutional Rights, fighting for Election Integrity, and supporting our public servants in Law Enforcement, Fire and EMS, and our Military men and women," Hamm said, according to the news release.
findings.note: Quoted by the Sun-Gazette from his re-election announcement release. He lists election integrity among his priorities without naming a specific ID rule. Article day not shown on the page, so date is month only.

findings.passage: Hamm, the news release said, has made significant and ground-breaking inroads in his tenure as representative.
findings.note: Same release, issued in his name, lists as a record item co-sponsoring over a dozen election-integrity bills including voter ID, signature verification and cleaning up voter rolls (full sentence on the page: "co-sponsoring over a dozen bills fighting for election integrity including Voter ID, signature verification and cleaning up voter rolls"). This is a self-description in a campaign release, not a specific bill record.
